message.content: {"caption":"Diagram of an iterative coding-agent improvement system that selects agents from an archive, modifies them, and evaluates their performance.","description":"A schematic shows an archive of coding agents, with a parent agent and a newly generated child agent. A large loop alternates between selecting an agent for self-modification and adding an evaluated agent back to the archive. On the right, the self-modification path combines an agent’s code repository with a self-improvement instruction to produce a code change intended to improve the agent. The evaluation path combines a task repository and task instruction to test a new coding agent, producing a code change intended to solve the task; the evaluated agent can then be added to the archive.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
